references.text: Ashdod is mentioned as one of the cities where the Anakites lived, referring to the same geographical area.
Describes the border toward Egypt (the River Sihor) and mentions the Philistine territory including Gaza and Ashdod.
Ashdod is mentioned as the place where the Philistines brought the ark of the covenant.
Ashdod and Gaza are listed among the five Philistine cities that sent a guilt offering to the Lord.
The prophet Amos proclaims judgment against Ashdod and its inhabitants.
Zephaniah prophesies that Gaza will be deserted and Ashdod will be driven out at midday.
Zechariah prophesies about the fall and destruction of Ashdod.
The Brook of Egypt (nachal Mitzrajim) is mentioned as the southwestern border of Israel's promised land.
The Brook of Egypt is mentioned as the southern border of Solomon's kingdom.
The Great Sea (the Mediterranean) is mentioned as Israel's western border.
